people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”
translations.bsb: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and to establish the throne of David over Israel and Judah, from Dan to Beersheba.”
translations.kjv: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.
translations.asv: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.
